Classification of basal implants (based on morphology)
                                                  Based on their morphology, basal implants are classified into disk-form implants, including the transosseous
                                                  implant (TOI), basal osseointegrated implant (BOI), and lateral implant; screw-form implants, comprising

                                                  including the BOI-BAC and BOI-BAC2 designs; and other specialized forms, such as the tuberopterygoid
                                                  (TPG) implant and the zygoma screw implant (ZSI) [16].
